# Stock sensor register comparison

Generated by tools/extract_sensor_registers.py from hash-pinned MAIN. All 161 table-fed write blocks validated against ARM instructions; all 70 mode IDs cross-checked against the independent geometry table. This is a comparison of programmed values, not a sensor datasheet or a patch.

Later dynamic writes to 0xCE and 0xD1–0xD3, receiver configuration, timing updates, and processing/buffer setup are outside this table comparison.
